svg.metadata:
flowchart TD Q([Search text]) --> U["Decision model reads the search: categories, facets, price limit"] Q --> I["Gemini Flash-Lite writes what the search refers to"] U --> R["Eight rankings inside the price limit: keyword, text, photo, style, facets"] I --> R R --> F["Fusion keeps the best 80, tag expansion adds up to 20"] F --> G{"Decision model reads each product's card and photo: p ≥ 0.35?"} G -->|yes| P(["Page, highest p first"]) G -->|no| D[Dropped]
%% @main Q U R F G P %% @peers U I %% @exit G -> D
